mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student (student_id, student_name, birth,gender, school, address, address_detail, entry_han_date, entry_book_date, app_id, app_password, created_at, center_code, grade_key, status_key, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{entryHanDate}, #{entryBookDate}, #{appId}, #{appPassword}, SYSDATETIME(), #{centerCode}, #{gradeKey}, #{statusKey}, #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, g.*, reg.registeredClassTypes as classType FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + cc.class_type FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS registeredClassTypes ) reg WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND ( reg.registeredClassTypes IS NULL OR reg.registeredClassTypes IN ('1','2') )

WITH latest_history AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM ERP_STATUS_HISTORY) SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school, g.grade_name AS grade, -- l.level_name AS level, s.gender, s.birth, s.address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate, s.created_at AS createdAt,
han.class_name AS hanClass, book.class_name AS bookClass,
CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel,
h.status_key AS status, sc.status_name AS statusName, h.reason FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN latest_history h ON s.student_id = h.student_id AND h.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ERP_GRADE_CODE g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key -- LEFT JOIN ERP_LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_key = l.level_key LEFT JOIN ERP_CENTER c ON s.center_code = c.center_code LEFT JOIN ERP_PARENT p ON p.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_STATUS_CODE sc ON sc.status_key = h.status_key
-- APPLY로 class_name 가져오기 OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 cc.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = '1' AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM') ) han
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 cc.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = '2' AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM') ) book
WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId};

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.status_name AS statusName, CASE WHEN s.entry_han_date IS NULL AND s.entry_book_date IS NULL THEN '미등록' WHEN s.entry_han_date IS NULL THEN s.entry_book_date WHEN s.entry_book_date IS NULL THEN s.entry_han_date WHEN s.entry_han_date <= s.entry_book_date THEN s.entry_han_date ELSE s.entry_book_date END AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 1 AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 2 AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code
WHERE 1 = 1 AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.user_code = #{userCode} )
ORDER BY s.id

WITH base AS (SELECT ta.student_id, cc.class_type, cc.class_name, u.user_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cc.class_key = t.class_key JOIN erp_user u ON u.user_code = t.user_code GROUP BY ta.student_id, cc.class_type, cc.class_name, u.user_name) SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, g.grade_name, a.hanclass, a.bookclass, a.hanteacher, a.bookteacher, (SELECT Max(sth.move_at) FROM erp_student_transfer_history sth WHERE sth.student_id = s.student_id) AS moveAt FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key OUTER apply ( SELECT hanClass = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.class_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '1' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''), bookClass = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.class_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '2' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''), hanTeacher = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.user_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '1' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''), bookTeacher = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.user_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '2' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') ) a WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY s.id;
mapper.update: UPDATE class_instance SET user_no = #{userNo} WHERE class_instance_no IN (SELECT ci.class_instance_no FROM student_class sc JOIN class_instance ci ON sc.class_instance_no = ci.class_instance_no JOIN class_code cc ON ci.class_no = cc.class_no WHERE sc.student_no = #{studentNo} AND cc.class_type = #{classType})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_transfer_history (student_no, from_user_no, to_user_no, class_type, transfer_reason, move_at, class_no, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentNo}, #{fromUser.userNo}, #{toUser.userNo}, #{classType}, #{transferReason}, #{classNo}, #{moveAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
mapper.select: SELECT center_code as centerCode, student_id as stuid, student_name as name, app_token as token FROM erp_student WHERE app_id = #{appId}
SELECT in_time, out_time, attendance_date, student_id, attendance_key FROM erp_student_attendance WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE TO_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE FROM_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.student_name as studentName, s.app_password as password, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, s.grade_key as gradeKey, s.app_id as appId, s.app_password as appPassword FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code WHERE s.app_id = #{appId}
